data.narrative:
Rebellions is a Series A-stage semiconductor chip company that has raised $850M to a current post-money valuation of $2.34B. The valuation is benchmarked against a universe of 10 private peers in the same sector plus a 3-ticker public comparator set (ALAB, NVDA, AMD), with top private peers including SambaNova Systems ($11.0B, Series F), Etched ($5.0B, Series E), and Tenstorrent ($2.7B, Series D).

Two valuation methods were applicable. Stage-progression analysis, applying a typical 2.0x Series A-to-next-stage step-up multiplier to the $2.3B last post-money valuation, implies $4.7B. Peer-median analysis across 10 same-sector companies with similar valuation positioning yields a median of $2.1B, with a range spanning $529M to $11.0B. Public-comp anchoring using Semiconductors P/S multiples (18.9x median across the three public tickers) was not applicable due to absence of target revenue data.

The triangulated analysis of these two applicable methods supports a valuation range of $1.8B (low) to $5.4B (high), with a median implied value of $3.4B. The current $2.34B valuation sits in the lower half of this range, between the peer-median floor and the stage-progression midpoint. Key uncertainties include the target's revenue trajectory and capital efficiency relative to the peer cohort, both of which would refine the stage-progression and peer-multiple estimates.
